items.name: Kestrel Issue Sidearm
items.description: The starter pistol. Everyone in Karst has fired one; most of them at the wrong person.

items.name: Halvard HV-7 Carbine
items.description: A guard's rifle. Boring, accurate, never jams, never surprises anyone.

items.name: Sable Works Streetsweeper
items.description: Pipe shotgun. In the Sink, "nice to meet you" is a sound.

items.name: Ostrom Pinlight
items.description: A laser pointer that grew up. Quiet, precise, useless against plate.

items.name: Sable Works Spitter
items.description: Sprays a caustic gel that keeps working after you stop. Don't stand downwind.

items.name: Ferry-make Slugthrower
items.description: Half of it fell out of the sky. The other half is a bicycle.

items.name: Kestrel Issue Flare Pistol
items.description: Meant to call a convoy. Also sets things on fire, which sometimes calls a convoy.

items.name: Old Works Arc-Pen
items.description: A soldering tool with ambitions. Runners carry it because it fits next to a rig.

items.name: Halvard HV-9 Battle Rifle
items.description: The rifle the HV-7 wanted to be. Spire security carry it with the safety off.

items.name: Halvard Longline DMR
items.description: Marksman's rifle. In the Scour, you hear it after you're already down.

items.name: Ostrom Lance
items.description: Corporate laser rifle. Draws a line from you to the problem and removes the problem.

items.name: Old Works Coilgun
items.description: Rails from a tram motor, capacitor from a vat. Sounds like a slammed door.

items.name: Sable Works Needler
items.description: Fires hypodermic darts. What's in them is up to you.

items.name: Sable Works Twelve
items.description: A proper shotgun, machined, with the maker's mark filed off out of habit.

items.name: Kestrel Issue Convoy SMG
items.description: Convoy guards get one each and a box of magazines. Spray, reload, repeat.

items.name: Ferry-make Meteor Cannon
items.description: A satellite thruster housing loaded with bolts. Heavy weapon (Hardline only).

items.name: Ostrom Arc Projector
items.description: Jumps between targets. Halvard uses it on crowds and calls it "de-escalation".

items.name: Sable Works Torch
items.description: Flamethrower. The Sink's answer to a locked door. Heavy weapon (Hardline only).

items.name: Chapel Foundry Tuning Fork
items.description: A dissonance projector. Cantor only. It does not make a sound you can hear; the target disagrees.

items.name: Halvard HV-12 Assault Rifle
items.description: Spire issue. If you see one outside the Spire, someone died for it.

items.name: Halvard Anvil LMG
items.description: Heavy weapon (Hardline only). Suppression as a personality.

items.name: Ostrom Scalpel
items.description: Surgical laser rifle. Ostrom says it's for eye clinics. Ostrom says a lot of things.

items.name: Ostrom Sunlance
items.description: Heavy weapon (Hardline only). Brief, bright, final.

items.name: Sable Works Widow
items.description: Needler with a nerve-agent reservoir. Illegal in the Core, which is where it is confiscated.

items.name: Old Works Railpistol
items.description: Coilgun tech, pocket size. Runners' choice for the walk home.

items.name: Ferry-make Ring-fall Rifle
items.description: Barrel from a satellite boom, sight from an optics grade. Nobody makes two alike.

items.name: Kestrel Issue Gate Gun
items.description: Gate-guard carbine, Kestrel's only tier-3 design. Ugly, cheap for what it is, replaces itself.

items.name: Chapel Foundry Choir Bell
items.description: Cantor only. A cone of pure disagreement. Wardens classify it as a musical instrument.

items.name: Ostrom Pulse Carbine
items.description: Energy counterpart to the HV-12, sold to Sablier security. Cleaner. Same result.

items.name: Kestrel Issue Baton
items.description: Starter melee. A stick that has been to meetings.

items.name: Sable Works Shiv
items.description: Fast, quiet, easily lost, easily replaced.

items.name: Ferry-make Ring Wrench
items.description: A tool for satellites. Also for people who touch your salvage.

items.name: Halvard Shock Baton
items.description: Adds shock on hit. Security issue; the humane option, by Halvard's definition.

items.name: Sable Works Machete
items.description: The Sink's ceremonial blade. The ceremony is short.

items.name: Old Works Arc Knuckles
items.description: Capacitor gloves. Two fast hits per swing. Don't shake hands.

items.name: Sable Works Etcher
items.description: A blade that keeps cutting after you've put it away.

items.name: Halvard Breaching Ram
items.description: Heavy weapon (Hardline only). Knocks down anything smaller than a door. Most things are.

items.name: Chapel Foundry Hand Bell
items.description: Cantor only. Touch-range dissonance. Mother Quell carries one and has never been seen to use it.

items.name: Containment Charge
items.description: Cuts a core's power from any tile within 3 of its hardware, through the wall. Single use. Halvard's answer to a locked server room.

items.name: Curfew Pass
items.description: Admits the holder to the Core during a Curfew. Expires after 7 days. Marked holders are refused at the line.

items.name: Row Pass
items.description: Opens a nonessential Sable back-room shortcut. Public bars and boards remain available.

items.name: Spire Visitor's Pass
items.description: Admits one non-Halvard character to the Spire Mezzanine for 30 minutes.

items.name: Silt Beacon
items.description: Marks a descent cell for the crew for one hour; crew members see it on the sector view from any cell.

items.name: Ring-fall Chart
items.description: Names the next Ring-fall ring one hour early. Sells to anyone who did not earn it.

items.name: Vesper's Card
items.description: A contract card. *Vesper, Tin Halo, Sodium Row.*

items.name: Warm Telemetry Unit
items.description: Site Zero salvage that is still warm.

items.name: Seal Beacon
items.description: A monitor beacon Halvard wants planted at the seal.

items.name: Sealed Template Canister
items.description: A canister from below the outworks. Sablier does not say what is in it.

items.name: Template Shield Rig
items.description: Shields walked templates from Sablier's recall signal.

items.name: Resonance Beacon
items.description: Quell's beacon for a cell that should not exist.

items.name: Listening Stake
items.description: A stake the Ferrymen drive at a conduit head to hear it hum.

items.name: Residual Fragment 99-B
items.description: A second copy of Ninety-Nine that says one thing.

items.name: Drop Cache
items.description: The cache under Terrace Nine.

items.name: Authority Image Copy
items.description: A copy of the Dispatcher's process image.

items.name: Holt's Hand Schedule
items.description: A convoy schedule written by hand. Late, unreliable, human.

items.name: Choir Beacon II
items.description: A beacon for the shaft head.

items.name: Ferrymen Repeater
items.description: A repeater for the Far Relay.

items.name: Stuck-door Package
items.description: A package behind a door that sticks.

items.name: Civic Pattern guard suit
items.description: Warden issue. The finish is blue.

items.name: Civic Pattern battle rifle
items.description: Warden issue. The finish is blue.

items.name: Civic Pattern shock baton
items.description: Warden issue. The finish is blue.

items.name: Apartment key
items.description: You hold one door open. The room beyond keeps its permissions.

items.name: Sealed commission parcel
items.description: A labelled parcel supplied for an accepted local commission.

items.name: Route marker
items.description: A labelled marker supplied for one accepted route survey.

items.name: Depot surplus manifest
items.description: A sealed work-order manifest naming the surplus warehouse latch.

items.name: Undercity Key
items.description: You carry an Exhale key. Its cut fits the Drowned bulkhead.
